meta.name: 广州教科版
meta.coverage: 小学一年级至初中三年级
meta.note_grade6_xia: 六年级下册已切换为《义务教育教科书 英语（三年级起点）六年级下册》(教育科学出版社, 2013)，5 个模块 10 个单元 · 内容按官方教材整理

上.title: Unit 1 Hello
上.lesson: Hello! I am Tom. What is your name? Hi, Tom. My name is Amy. Nice to meet you!
上.lessonCN: 您好！我是Tom。您叫什么名字？嗨，汤姆，我叫艾米很高兴认识你！

上.title: Unit 2 Numbers
上.lesson: Let's count! One, two, three, four, five. I have five fingers on my hand. Can you count with me?
上.lessonCN: 让我们数数！一，二，三，四，五。我的手上有五根手指。你能和我一起数数吗？

下.title: Unit 1 Colors
下.lesson: Look at the rainbow! I see red, yellow, and blue. I like green. What color do you like? I like black.
下.lessonCN: 看看彩虹！我看到红色、黄色和蓝色。我喜欢绿色，你喜欢什么颜色？我喜欢黑色。

下.title: Unit 2 My Family
下.lesson: This is my family. My mum, my dad and me. I have a baby sister too. I love my family. We are happy together.
下.lessonCN: 这是我的家人。我妈妈，我爸爸和我。我也有一个小妹妹。我爱我的家人。我们在一起很开心。

上.title: Unit 1 Animals
上.lesson: I have many pets. I have a cat and a dog. I also have fish and a rabbit. My cat is black. My dog is white. They are my good friends.
上.lessonCN: 我有很多宠物。我有一只猫和一只狗。我还有鱼和兔子。我的猫是黑色的。我的狗是白色的。他们是我的好朋友。

上.title: Unit 2 My Body
上.lesson: This is my body. I have one head and two hands. I have two feet. I have two eyes and two ears. I use my eyes to see and my ears to listen.
上.lessonCN: 这是我的身体。我有一个头和两只手。我有两只脚。我有两只眼睛和两只耳朵。我用眼睛看，用耳朵听。

下.title: Unit 1 Fruits
下.lesson: I like fruits. I like apples and bananas. My mum likes oranges. My dad likes grapes. Fruits are sweet and healthy. Do you like fruits?
下.lessonCN: 我喜欢水果，我喜欢苹果和香蕉。我妈妈喜欢橘子。我爸爸喜欢葡萄。水果又甜又健康。你喜欢水果吗？

下.title: Unit 2 Weather
下.lesson: Today is sunny. I am happy. Yesterday was rainy and cold. Tomorrow will be windy. I like sunny days. What's the weather like today?
下.lessonCN: 今天阳光明媚，我很开心。昨天又雨又冷。明天会有风。我喜欢阳光明媚的日子。今天天气怎么样？

上.title: Unit 1 School Things
上.lesson: Look at my bag. There are books, pens and pencils in it. This is my school bag. I like it very much.
上.lessonCN: 看看我的包。里面有书、钢笔和铅笔。这是我的书包。我非常喜欢它。

上.title: Unit 2 My Classroom

words.example: The teacher writes on the blackboard.

上.lesson: This is our classroom. It is big and clean. There is a blackboard and a big window. Our teacher stands in front of the blackboard. I like my classroom.
上.lessonCN: 这是我们的教室。它又大又干净。有一块黑板和一扇大窗户。我们的老师站在黑板前。我喜欢我的教室。

下.title: Unit 1 My Day

words.example: I go to school by bus.

下.lesson: I get up at seven o'clock. I have breakfast at seven thirty. Then I go to school. I have lunch at twelve o'clock. I go home at five o'clock.
下.lessonCN: 我七点钟起床。我七点半吃早饭。然后我去上学。我十二点钟吃午饭。我五点钟回家。

下.title: Unit 2 Hobbies
下.lesson: I have many hobbies. I like to play football and read books. My sister likes to sing and dance. My brother likes to draw. What are your hobbies?
下.lessonCN: 我有很多爱好。我喜欢踢足球和看书。我姐姐喜欢唱歌和跳舞。我哥哥喜欢画画。您的爱好是什么？

上.title: Unit 1 My Room

words.example: There is a bed in my room.
My desk is near the window.

上.lesson: This is my room. There is a bed, a desk and a chair in it. There is a window near the desk. I like my room very much.
上.lessonCN: 这是我的房间。里面有一张床、一张桌子和一把椅子。桌子附近有一扇窗户。我非常喜欢我的房间。

上.title: Unit 2 Clothes
上.lesson: I am wearing a blue shirt and black shoes. My sister is wearing a pink dress. It is cold today, so I wear a coat and a hat. What are you wearing?
上.lessonCN: 我穿着蓝色衬衫和黑色鞋子。我妹妹穿着粉红色的连衣裙。今天天气很冷，所以我穿着外套和帽子。你穿的是什么？

下.title: Unit 1 Food I Like
下.lesson: I like vegetables and fruit. They are healthy. I have rice and noodles too. What's your favorite food? I also like bread with milk in the morning.
下.lessonCN: 我喜欢蔬菜和水果。它们很健康。我也有米饭和面条。您最喜欢的食物是什么？我也喜欢早上的牛奶面包。

下.title: Unit 2 Seasons
下.lesson: There are four seasons in a year. Spring is warm and colorful. Summer is hot and sunny. Autumn is cool. Winter is cold and snowy. My favorite season is spring.
下.lessonCN: 一年有四个季节。春天温暖多彩。夏天炎热阳光充足。秋天很凉爽，冬天又冷又下雪。我最喜欢的季节是春天。

上.title: Unit 1 My Dream Job

words.example: I want to be a scientist.

上.lesson: What do you want to be when you grow up? I want to be a scientist. I want to help people. My brother wants to be an engineer.
上.lessonCN: 你长大后想成为什么样的人？我想成为一名科学家。我想帮助别人。我哥哥想成为一名工程师。

上.title: Unit 2 Travel
上.lesson: I love to travel. Last summer, I traveled to Beijing by plane. I visited the Great Wall and the Forbidden City. It was a wonderful trip. This winter, I will travel to Shanghai by train.
上.lessonCN: 我喜欢旅行。去年夏天，我乘飞机去了北京。我参观了长城和紫禁城。这是一次美妙的旅程。今年冬天，我将乘火车去上海。

下.title: Unit 1 Protect the Earth
下.lesson: The Earth is our home. We should protect it. We should save water and plant more trees. We should not pollute rivers. Let's recycle paper and plastic to make our planet greener.
下.lessonCN: 地球是我们的家园。我们应该保护它。我们应该节约用水，种更多的树。我们不应该污染河流。让我们回收纸张和塑料，让地球更环保。

下.title: Unit 2 Sports
下.lesson: Exercise is important for our health. I play football with my classmates after school. My sister likes swimming. My father goes running every morning. What sports do you like?
下.lessonCN: 锻炼对我们的健康很重要。放学后我和同学一起踢足球。我姐姐喜欢游泳。我父亲每天早上都跑步。您喜欢什么运动？

上.title: Unit 1 How Tall Are You?
上.lesson: How tall are you, Mike? I'm 165 cm tall. I'm taller than you. How old is your brother? He is 12. He is younger than me.
上.lessonCN: 你有多高，迈克？我身高165厘米。我比你高。你弟弟多大了？他12岁，比我小。

上.title: Unit 2 Last Weekend
上.lesson: What did you do last weekend? I visited my grandparents. I cleaned my room and washed my clothes. It was a busy weekend.
上.lessonCN: 你上周末做了什么？我去看望了我的祖父母。我打扫了房间，洗了衣服。这是一个繁忙的周末。

下.title: Unit 1 Slow and steady wins the race
下.topic: 龟兔赛跑与坚持的意义
grammar: 一般过去时（规则/不规则动词过去式）

words.example: He carried the books to the library.
Why are you in such a hurry?
Be patient, and you will succeed.
The hare was sad when he lost.
Slow and steady wins the race.
The tortoise is slow but steady.

lessons.title: 对话 · Why are you in such a hurry?
lessons.en:
Janet: Why are you in such a hurry?
Jiamin: I'm going to the library. I have to return a book.
Janet: You are like that silly hare.
Jiamin: Hare? What do you mean?
Xiaoling: You know... the old story about the tortoise and the hare.
Janet: Yes! One day a tortoise and a hare had a race. The hare was sure he would win, so he took a rest. He was too proud and careless.
Xiaoling: The slow but careful tortoise won the race.
Jiamin: Ahh. I understand now. If I want to do something well, I must be patient and careful. Slow and steady wins the race!
lessons.cn:
Janet：你为什么这么匆忙？
Jiamin：我要去图书馆还一本书。
Janet：你真像那只傻兔子。
Jiamin：兔子？什么意思？
Xiaoling：你知道的……关于乌龟和兔子的那个老故事。
Janet：对！从前，乌龟和兔子赛跑。兔子以为自己肯定赢，就停下来休息。它太骄傲又太大意了。
Xiaoling：缓慢但认真的乌龟赢了比赛。
Jiamin：啊，我明白了。如果我想把事情做好，就必须耐心细致。慢而稳，才能赢！

lessons.title: 故事 · The tortoise and the hare
lessons.en: One day, a tortoise and a hare decided to have a race. The hare thought he was much faster than the tortoise, so he laughed at the tortoise. During the race, the hare ran fast, then stopped to take a nap under a tree. The tortoise walked slowly and steadily, never stopping. When the hare woke up, the tortoise was already near the finish line. The hare ran as fast as he could, but it was too late. The tortoise won the race. The hare learned a lesson: slow and steady wins the race.
lessons.cn: 一天，乌龟和兔子决定赛跑。兔子觉得自己比乌龟快得多，就嘲笑乌龟。比赛中，兔子跑得飞快，然后在树下打起了盹儿。乌龟一步步缓慢而坚定地走着，从不停下。兔子醒来时，乌龟已经快到终点线了。兔子拼命跑，但为时已晚。最后乌龟赢了。兔子得到了一个教训：慢而稳，才能赢。

下.title: Unit 2 Waiting for another hare
下.topic: 守株待兔与不劳而获的危害

words.example: The hare crashed into the tree.
The car crashed into the wall.
The hare fell to the ground.
He thought it was easy to get food.
From then on, he stopped working.
He stopped working in the field.

lessons.title: 对话 · What are you reading?
lessons.en:
Tom: What are you reading?
Amy: I'm reading a story about a farmer.
Tom: What happened to him?
Amy: One day, a hare crashed into a tree and died. The farmer picked it up and took it home.
Tom: That's easy! Did he get another hare?
Amy: No. From then on, he didn't work in the field. He waited for another hare to crash into the tree. But no hare came. His crops died.
Tom: Oh! That's a bad idea. He should work hard.
Amy: Yes. We shouldn't wait for good luck to come. We should work hard for our dreams.
lessons.cn:
Tom：你在看什么？
Amy：我在看一个关于一个农夫的故事。
Tom：他发生了什么事？
Amy：有一天，一只兔子撞到了一棵树上死了。农夫把它捡起来带回家。
Tom：那多容易啊！他后来又得到兔子了吗？
Amy：没有。从那以后，他就不去田里干活了，只等着另一只兔子再撞上那棵树。可是再也没有兔子来。他的庄稼全都死了。
Tom：哎！这可真是个坏主意，他应该努力干活才对。
Amy：是啊。我们不能光等着好运上门，应该为梦想而努力。

lessons.title: 故事 · Waiting for another hare
lessons.en: Once upon a time, there was a farmer. One day, he was working in the field. Suddenly, a hare ran fast and crashed into a big tree. It died. The farmer picked up the hare and took it home. He was very happy. "How easy it is to get food!" he thought. From then on, he stopped working in the field. He sat under the tree every day, waiting for another hare to come. But no hare came again. His crops died because he didn't take care of them. The farmer learned a lesson: good luck won't come again. We must work hard to get what we want.
lessons.cn: 从前有一个农夫。一天，他正在田里干活，突然一只兔子飞快地跑过来，撞到一棵大树上死了。农夫捡起那只兔子带回家，非常高兴：“弄到食物真容易啊！”他想。从那以后，他就不再下田干活，每天坐在那棵树下等下一只兔子。可是再也没有兔子来了。庄稼因为没人照料全都死了。农夫得到了一个教训：好运不会再来，我们必须努力才能得到想要的东西。

下.title: Unit 3 What animal is it?
下.topic: 动物特征描述与濒危动物识别

words.example: The panda lives in bamboo forests.
The elephant has a long trunk.
The blue whale is the largest animal in the world.
The giraffe has a long neck.
The tiger is a big cat.

lessons.title: 对话 · What animal is it?
lessons.en:
Lily: What animal is it?
Mike: It's a panda. It's black and white. It lives in China.
Lily: Is it an endangered animal?
Mike: Yes. Pandas are endangered. There are not many pandas left in the wild.
Lily: What about elephants?
Mike: Elephants are also endangered. They are the largest land animals. They have long trunks.
Lily: How can we help them?
Mike: We can protect their homes and not buy things made from their parts.
lessons.cn:
Lily：这是什么动物？
Mike：是熊猫。它是黑白相间的，生活在中国。
Lily：它是濒危动物吗？
Mike：是的。熊猫是濒危动物，野外剩下的熊猫不多了。
Lily：那大象呢？
Mike：大象也是濒危动物。它们是陆地上最大的动物，有长长的鼻子。
Lily：我们怎样才能帮助它们？
Mike：我们可以保护它们的家园，不买用它们身体部分做成的东西。

下.title: Unit 4 We can save the animals
下.topic: 动物保护措施与环境保护

words.example: We can save the endangered animals.
People kill animals for their fur.
Many animals live in the forest.
We should keep the river clean.
Your actions are helpful to the animals.
Many animals disappeared because of pollution.
We should protect animals and the Earth.
We don't want animals to disappear forever.
Some people kill animals for their fur.
Don't buy things made from animal fur.
This bag is made from plastic.
There are only a few pandas left.

lessons.title: 对话 · Many animals are in danger. What…
lessons.en:
Tom: Many animals are in danger. What can we do?
Amy: We can save them. First, we can protect their homes.
Tom: Their homes? Like forests and rivers?
Amy: Yes. People cut down forests and pollute rivers. So animals lose their homes.
Tom: What else can we do?
Amy: We can not buy things made from animal parts, like ivory or fur.
Tom: That's right. We can also tell our friends to help.
Amy: Yes! Every small action can help save the animals.
lessons.cn:
Tom：很多动物都处于危险之中，我们能做点什么？
Amy：我们可以拯救它们。首先，我们可以保护它们的家园。
Tom：家园？像森林和河流那样的地方？
Amy：对。人们砍伐森林、污染河流，动物就失去了家园。
Tom：我们还能做什么？
Amy：我们可以不买象牙、皮毛这些用动物身体部分做成的东西。
Tom：没错。我们还可以告诉朋友们一起帮忙。
Amy：对！每一个小小的行动都能帮助拯救动物。

下.title: Unit 5 Dr Sun Yatsen
下.topic: 历史名人孙中山生平与贡献

words.example: Dr Sun Yatsen was a great leader.
He is important in Chinese history.
He wanted to free the people.
The park is named after him.

lessons.title: 对话 · Do you know Dr Sun Yatsen?
lessons.en:
Jiamin: Do you know Dr Sun Yatsen?
Xiaoling: Yes, he was a great leader in China.
Jiamin: When was he born?
Xiaoling: He was born in 1866 in Guangdong.
Jiamin: What did he do?
Xiaoling: He loved the Chinese people. He tried to change China and free the people.
Jiamin: He is very famous all over the world.
Xiaoling: Yes, many streets, parks and schools are named after him.
lessons.cn:
Jiamin：你知道孙中山先生吗？
Xiaoling：知道，他是中国伟大的领袖。
Jiamin：他是什么时候出生的？
Xiaoling：他 1866 年出生在广东。
Jiamin：他做了什么？
Xiaoling：他深爱中国人民，努力改变中国，解放人民。
Jiamin：他在全世界都非常有名。
Xiaoling：是的，很多街道、公园和学校都以他的名字命名。

lessons.title: 故事 · Dr Sun Yatsen
lessons.en: Dr Sun Yatsen was one of the greatest leaders in Chinese history. He was born in 1866 in Cuiheng, Guangdong. He loved the Chinese people very much. At that time, the life of common people was very hard. Dr Sun Yatsen wanted to change China. He worked hard to free the people and build a new China. People respect him very much. Today, many streets, parks and schools are named after him all over China.
lessons.cn: 孙中山先生是中国历史上最伟大的领袖之一。他 1866 年出生在广东翠亨村。他非常热爱中国人民。那时普通百姓生活很苦，孙中山先生想要改变中国。他努力解放人民，建立新中国。人们非常尊敬他。今天，全国各地的许多街道、公园和学校都以他的名字命名。

下.title: Unit 6 Early years of Deng Jiaxian
下.topic: 科学家邓稼先少年与生平事迹
grammar: 一般过去时描述人物早年经历

words.example: Deng Jiaxian was a great scientist.
He made great contributions to China.
He worked for the country all his life.

lessons.title: 对话 · Do you know Deng Jiaxian?
lessons.en:
Janet: Do you know Deng Jiaxian?
Ben: Yes, he was a great Chinese scientist.
Janet: What was he like when he was a child?
Ben: He was very clever and hard-working.
Janet: Did he study hard at school?
Ben: Yes. He liked reading and learning new things.
Janet: What did he do later?
Ben: He worked for our country and made great contributions to China.
lessons.cn:
Janet：你知道邓稼先吗？
Ben：知道，他是中国一位伟大的科学家。
Janet：他小时候是什么样的？
Ben：他非常聪明、勤奋。
Janet：他在学校努力学习吗？
Ben：是的，他喜欢阅读，喜欢学习新东西。
Janet：他后来做了什么？
Ben：他为我们国家工作，为中国做出了巨大的贡献。

lessons.title: 故事 · Early years of Deng Jiaxian
lessons.en: Deng Jiaxian was a famous great scientist of China. When he was a little boy, he was quiet, clever and thoughtful. He loved reading books very much. He studied very hard at school. He always asked good questions and liked thinking. He loved his country from an early age. Later, he studied science and worked for China all his life. He is a hero in people's hearts.
lessons.cn: 邓稼先是中国著名的大科学家。小时候，他就安静、聪明、爱思考，非常喜欢读书，在学校学习刻苦。他常常提出好问题，喜欢动脑筋。他从小就热爱祖国。后来他学习科学，一生为中国工作，永远活在人们心中。

下.title: Unit 7 It's the polite thing to do
下.topic: 公共场合礼仪、排队、言行举止

words.example: It's impolite to push in line.

lessons.title: 对话 · Look, Jiamin. Don't push in line.
lessons.en:
Xiaoling: Look, Jiamin. Don't push in line.
Jiamin: Sorry. What should I do?
Xiaoling: You should queue up. It's polite.
Jiamin: What other polite things should we do?
Xiaoling: We should speak quietly in the library. We shouldn't talk loudly.
Jiamin: I see. Good manners make our life better.
lessons.cn:
Xiaoling：Jiamin，看，不要插队。
Jiamin：对不起，那我该怎么做？
Xiaoling：你应该排队，这样才礼貌。
Jiamin：我们还应该做哪些礼貌的事？
Xiaoling：在图书馆里我们应该小声说话，不应该大声喧哗。
Jiamin：我懂了。良好的礼仪让生活更美好。

下.title: Unit 8 The magic words
下.topic: 日常礼貌用语：请、谢谢、对不起

words.example: Excuse me, where is the library?

lessons.title: 对话 · Can you help me pass the book, p…
lessons.en:
Ben: Can you help me pass the book, please?
Tom: Sure. Here you are.
Ben: Thank you so much.
Tom: You're welcome. These are magic words.
Ben: Magic words?
Tom: Yes. "Please", "Thank you" and "Sorry". They make people happy.
lessons.cn:
Ben：可以请你把那本书递给我吗？
Tom：当然可以，给你。
Ben：非常感谢。
Tom：不客气，这些都是魔法词汇。
Ben：魔法词汇？
Tom：对。“请”“谢谢”和“对不起”，它们能让人开心。

下.title: Unit 9 Where will you go?
下.topic: 假期旅行计划、地点与出行方式
grammar: 一般将来时 will / be going to
Where/What 将来时特殊疑问句

words.example: I want to travel in summer holiday.
We will visit the Great Wall.
I will take a train to Shanghai.
We have a long summer holiday.

lessons.title: 对话 · Summer holiday is coming. Where …
lessons.en:
Xiaoling: Summer holiday is coming. Where will you go?
Janet: I will go to Beijing with my parents.
Xiaoling: How will you go there?
Janet: We will go by plane. It's fast.
Xiaoling: What will you do there?
Janet: We will visit the Great Wall and the Summer Palace.
lessons.cn:
Xiaoling：暑假快到了，你要去哪里？
Janet：我和父母一起去北京。
Xiaoling：你们怎么去？
Janet：我们坐飞机去，比较快。
Xiaoling：你们在那儿要做什么？
Janet：我们要去参观长城和颐和园。

下.title: Unit 10 I can't wait to see you
下.topic: 期待见面、写信、邮件、告别
grammar: can't wait to 固定句型

words.example: I can't wait to see my friends.
I will send you an email.
Please write an email to me.

lessons.title: 对话 · I will go back to my hometown th…
lessons.en:
Jiamin: I will go back to my hometown this holiday.
Ben: That's great! Will you meet your old friends?
Jiamin: Yes. I can't wait to see them.
Ben: Will you write emails to me?
Jiamin: Sure. I will send you some photos too.
Ben: Have a wonderful time!
lessons.cn:
Jiamin：这个假期我要回家乡。
Ben：太好了！你会见到老朋友吗？
Jiamin：会的，我迫不及待想见他们。
Ben：你会给我写邮件吗？
Jiamin：当然会，我还会给你发一些照片。
Ben：祝你玩得开心！

上.title: Unit 1 My Diary

words.example: I keep a diary every day.

上.lesson: Today is Sunday. The weather is sunny. I went to the library in the morning. I read books there. In the afternoon, I played basketball with my friends.
上.lessonCN: 今天是周日，天气晴朗。我早上去了图书馆。我在那里读书。下午，我和朋友一起打篮球。

上.title: Unit 2 School Life
上.lesson: At school, I have many subjects. I study Chinese, English, math, science and history. My favorite subject is English because I love learning new languages. What is your favorite subject?
上.lessonCN: 在学校，我有很多科目。我学习中文、英语、数学、科学和历史。我最喜欢的科目是英语，因为我喜欢学习新语言。您最喜欢的科目是什么？

下.title: Unit 1 Environment
下.lesson: Our environment is very important. We need clean air and clean water. We should not throw garbage on the street. Everyone can help to make our city more beautiful.
下.lessonCN: 我们的环境非常重要。我们需要干净的空气和水。我们不应该把垃圾扔到街上。每个人都可以帮助我们的城市变得更美丽。

下.title: Unit 2 Technology
下.lesson: Modern technology has changed our lives. We use computers and phones every day. We can send emails and shop online. The internet connects us to the world. Technology makes our lives easier and more fun.
下.lessonCN: 现代技术改变了我们的生活。我们每天都使用电脑和电话。我们可以发送电子邮件和在线购物。互联网将我们与世界联系起来。科技让我们的生活更轻松、更有趣。

上.title: Unit 1 What's the matter?

words.example: Take the medicine three times a day.

上.lesson: What's the matter, Tom? I have a bad cold and a headache. You should drink hot water and take some medicine. Thank you for your advice.
上.lessonCN: 怎么了，汤姆？我患有重感冒和头痛。您应该喝热水并服用一些药物。感谢您的建议。

上.title: Unit 2 Hobbies
上.lesson: Reading is a good hobby. It can help you learn many things. You can read at home, in the library or in the park. Reading makes you smart.
上.lessonCN: 阅读是一种很好的爱好。它可以帮助你学到很多东西。您可以在家里、图书馆或公园里阅读。阅读让你变得聪明。

下.title: Unit 1 Volunteering
下.lesson: Last Saturday, I worked as a volunteer in my community. We helped clean the park and visited the elderly. It felt good to help others. I learned that volunteering makes our community better and makes us happier.
下.lessonCN: 上周六，我在社区做志愿者。我们帮助打扫了公园，并拜访了老人。帮助别人感觉很好。我了解到，志愿服务可以让我们的社区变得更好，让我们更快乐。

下.title: Unit 2 My Hometown
下.lesson: My hometown is Guangzhou. It is a beautiful and modern city. We have tall buildings and old traditional houses. The food is very delicious. I love my hometown very much and I am proud to live here.
下.lessonCN: 我的家乡是广州。这是一座美丽而现代化的城市。我们有高层建筑和古老的传统房屋。食物非常美味。我非常爱我的家乡，我很自豪能住在这里。

上.title: Unit 1 Famous Places
上.lesson: The Great Wall is one of the most famous places in China. It is about 21196 kilometers long. It is a wonder of the world. Many people visit it every year.
上.lessonCN: 长城是中国最著名的地方之一。全长约21196公里。这是世界的奇迹。每年都有很多人来参观。

上.title: Unit 2 Inventions
上.lesson: Inventions have changed our world. The light bulb was invented by Thomas Edison. It changed the way we live. The telephone was invented by Alexander Bell. Today, we enjoy many useful inventions in our daily lives.
上.lessonCN: 发明改变了我们的世界。灯泡是由托马斯·爱迪生发明的。它改变了我们的生活方式。电话是由亚历山大·贝尔发明的。今天，我们在日常生活中享受着许多有用的发明。

下.title: Unit 1 Future Plans
下.lesson: In the future, I plan to go to a good university. I want to major in computer science because I love technology. After graduation, I hope to start my own company. I will work hard to achieve my dreams.
下.lessonCN: 将来，我打算去一所好大学。我想主修计算机科学，因为我热爱技术。毕业后，我希望创办自己的公司。我会努力实现我的梦想。

下.title: Unit 2 Global Issues
下.lesson: Our world faces many global issues today. Global warming affects our weather. Many children in poor countries need education. We all hope for peace and a better world. Each of us can make a small difference.
下.lessonCN: 当今世界面临着许多全球性问题。全球变暖影响着我们的天气。贫穷国家的许多儿童需要教育。我们都希望和平和更美好的世界。我们每个人都可以做出小小的改变。
